# WSL account TOML fallback
Tomli 2.0.1, unmodified Python source copied from the local pip 24.2 vendor bundle.
Upstream: https://github.com/hukkin/tomli/tree/2.0.1
License: MIT; full notice in LICENSE. Upstream metadata supports Python >=3.7.
The standalone WSL account worker loads this source in memory when neither tomllib nor tomli is installed.
The gateway also uses it to validate independent Codex homes on Python versions before 3.11.
